_comment: One neutral preset per camera film stock. Engine defaults + grain / halation / DIR couplers on, output saturation -15, print stock by family (cine -> kodak_2383, Fuji -> crystal archive, otherwise portra_endura), slide stocks via scanFilm. Grain is deliberately left at the engine default - see docs/CAMERA_PLAN.md for why ISO-derived particle areas were withdrawn.

presets.name: PORTRA 160
presets.description: Kodak Portra 160 — ISO 160. Neutral rendering: engine defaults plus grain, halation and DIR couplers on, output saturation -15. Grain is at the engine default pending calibration: the ISO-derived particle areas drove particle counts into a pathological branch of the binomial sampler.
